source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 4 同主题完形(我的成人礼/印度圣线的故事/为庆典做准备/一场误会式的礼物习俗/校友返校的一天/一个珍贵的家庭传统)。用词限 U4/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: My Coming-of-Age Day
passages.text: Last spring my school held a special (1)____ for all the students who had turned eighteen. We dressed up in clean, smart clothes and walked onto the (2)____ one by one. After that, each of us made a quiet (5)____ to study hard and to look after our families. The most touching (6)____ came at the end, when we offered a deep bow to our parents to thank them for their (7)____. Many of them could not hold back their tears. That day will always (8)____ in my heart as the moment I truly began to grow (9)____. Now, whenever I face something difficult, I remember the (10)____ I made and try to do my best.

passages.title: The Story of the Sacred Thread

passages.title: A Surprising Birthday Custom
passages.text: When my pen pal in Finland turned one month old, her family followed an unusual (1)____. Long ago, the government began to (2)____ every new mother a large box. passages.title: A Day at Homecoming
